limitations: Conservative static conditional-branch closure, not an observed dynamic trace. __InitRtns register call resolved solely to exact five proved XI targets.

__CMain code_chunks/body_sha256/edges describe the COMPLETE74B body41afaa..41aff4; startup_execution_code_chunks is a DISTINCT69B subset ending41afef. Full function metadata is not authorization to execute/restore its post-main JMPexit path. Exit_418c0f and finalization closure remain deferred.

All raw normalized matcher suggestions are heuristic only: generic JMP/RET/FF25 matches and _ustrdup false positive are rejected. Manual classification rationale/individual byte ranges are authoritative candidates.
Legacy-variant identities are source/public/fixup/edge-correlated CRT family candidates, not a claim old body byte-equals shipped object or that all descendants of startup are automatically CRT.
Registered SEH/FP callbacks are not called in healthy startup and remain masked/HOLD if reached; no new thread, child, TLS callback, unclassified initializer or unexpected breakpoint is accepted.
DGROUP and BSS stay loader-owned original state; callback and initializer pins must be validated live. Exact code data _IsTable must be restored alongside CRT NTInit.
Original native compatibility/GS repair owner guards remain separate runtime requirements; static analysis does not waive any of them.
